== Original and later persona-title states ==
The printed title changed from “Floating Refinery” to “Tibanna Floating Refinery”. The lore also changed. The deployment limit of one per sector was removed, a battleground-site requirement was added, and the two-dot restriction became unique. Both source images have been checked. The original has its own full card article at [[Floating Refinery (V)]]. Compilation dates do not establish the precise effective date of each state. The dated source-history audit remains open.
